note: B34-DEF-014. Every entry here is a documented, evidence-based exception for a build/dev-tool-only advisory that npm's severity label alone would otherwise flag as release-blocking. Removing a package from this file re-enables a hard failure for it. Adding a package here requires the same evidence standard: confirmed dependency path (npm explain) AND a grep of app/components/services/hooks/contexts/lib/supabase/functions confirming no direct import from shipped source.

picomatch.status: INFORMATIONAL — not read by scripts/check-dependency-reachability.js and grants no exception. Triage record only.
picomatch.summary: ReDoS (CWE-1333) when picomatch compiles a caller-supplied single-branch repeated extglob pattern such as +(*).
picomatch.vulnerableRange: picomatch <=4.0.7; firstPatchedVersion: none. 4.0.7 is the registry latest, so no lockfile-only upgrade can resolve it.
picomatch.timeline: published 2026-10-19; GitHub-reviewed 2026-11-17 (entered npm audit; the gate then reported 18 high findings with reason=leaf-picomatch-unapproved on every branch); withdrawn 2026-11-18T15:38:56Z. On 2026-11-19 the live `npm audit --omit=dev` no longer reports picomatch and the unchanged gate passes on rebuild/backend-authority-v2 @ e58125a2.
picomatch.upstreamPosition: Upstream picomatch maintainers rejected the report: globs compile to regular expressions and the risk only exists when untrusted users supply glob patterns. The proposed fix (micromatch/picomatch#235) was closed unmerged.
picomatch.reachability: BUILD_DEV_ONLY. Every path is Jest test tooling (react-native -> babel-jest/jest-environment-node -> @jest/* -> jest-haste-map/jest-util/micromatch/anymatch), the Metro file watcher (react-native -> @react-native/community-cli-plugin -> metro -> metro-file-map -> micromatch, and metro -> jest-worker -> jest-util), or Expo CLI/config loading (@expo/cli, @expo/metro-config, @expo/config -> sucrase -> tinyglobby/fdir). Those tools compile glob patterns from their own config, not from app users. No shipped code passes a user-controlled string to a glob matcher.
picomatch.evidence: (1) Zero imports of picomatch, micromatch, anymatch, fdir, tinyglobby, sucrase, metro-file-map, jest-*, @jest/*, babel-jest, @expo/cli, @expo/metro-config or @expo/config from app.js, index.js, server.js or app/components/services/hooks/contexts/lib/src/stores/modules/constants/types/supabase (Edge Functions included). (2) `npx expo export --source-maps` for android and ios: none of the 18 flagged packages appears among the ~2,075 bundle sources. The only @expo/cli file bundled is build/metro-require/require.js, Metro's module-system shim, which does not use picomatch. (3) server.js requires only express, cors and dotenv; their 78-node lockfile closure contains none of these packages.
picomatch.whyNoException: The gate matches exceptions by package name, not by advisory. A standing picomatch BUILD_DEV_ONLY entry would therefore pre-approve any future high picomatch advisory and its aggregate parents without review, so none is added while the audit does not report this advisory. If GitHub reinstates GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf, re-run this triage. If it still holds, add an `exceptions` entry for ["picomatch"] with severity high, classification BUILD_DEV_ONLY and aggregateParents exactly equal to flaggedAggregateParents. Do not use any broader entry.

exceptions.reachability: CVE-2026-93687 is in braces pattern expansion. In this locked tree every path to braces is through micromatch beneath Jest or Metro/React Native CLI build/test tooling; braces is not part of the shipped Hermes application runtime. npm audit propagates the leaf advisory severity up through those aggregate parent packages, including the runtime react-native package, even though the vulnerable path under react-native is its bundled CLI/Jest toolchain.
exceptions.evidence: Lockfile paths include react-native -> @react-native/community-cli-plugin -> metro-file-map -> micromatch -> braces; react-native -> babel-jest -> @jest/transform -> micromatch/jest-haste-map -> braces; and react-native -> jest-environment-node -> @jest/environment/@jest/fake-timers -> jest-message-util -> micromatch -> braces. No shipped source directly imports braces or the Jest/Metro aggregate packages. GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm affects braces <=3.0.3 and, as of 2026-10-04, has no patched release. The gate accepts an aggregate parent only when its npm-audit via graph resolves exclusively to this approved leaf and that parent is explicitly listed here; a direct high/critical advisory on react-native or any aggregate parent still fails closed.
exceptions.fixAvailable: No patched braces release exists as of 2026-10-04. Track upstream; remove this exception once a patched braces version is available in the governed Expo/React Native dependency graph.
